{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicates = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Check for sample_seq per patient
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {num_duplicates}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {len(df_grouped[df_grouped > 1])}")
print(f"Total number of unique patient_ids (before deduplication): {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
